module TopModule (
  input [7:0] a,
  input [7:0] b,
  output [7:0] s,
  output overflow
);

  wire [7:0] temp_1, temp_2, temp_3, temp_4;
  wire temp_5, temp_6;

  assign temp_1 = a & b;            // AND gate operations
  assign temp_2 = a | b;            // OR gate operations
  assign temp_3 = a ^ b;            // XOR gate operations
  assign temp_4 = ~(a & b);         // NAND gate operations
  
  assign s = (temp_1 & temp_2) | temp_3; // Resultant logic for s

  assign temp_5 = &s;                   // AND reduction
  assign temp_6 = |temp_4;                  // OR reduction
  
  assign overflow = temp_5 ^ temp_6;           // Resultant logic for overflow

endmodule

module ROM (
    input wire [7:0] addr,        // 8-bit Address input
    output reg [15:0] dout        // 16-bit Data output
);

always @(*) begin
    case (addr[1:0])              // Switch based on lower 2 bits of addr
        2'b00: dout = 16'b0000000000000011; // Output when addr[1:0] is 00
        2'b01: dout = 16'b0000000000001100; // Output when addr[1:0] is 01
        2'b10: dout = 16'b0000001111000000; // Output when addr[1:0] is 10
        2'b11: dout = 16'b1111111111111111; // Output when addr[1:0] is 11
        default: dout = 16'b0000000000000000; // Default output
    endcase
end

endmodule
